statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Owner designated security lead and CMMC Affirming Official; no affirmation without evidence
Yearly risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk decision rules; payment-diversion risks always treated
Yearly evaluation with an outside reader before each CMMC self-assessment
Yearly policy review
Sanctions for any future employee
Written, time-limited exceptions; never used to claim a CMMC requirement is Met
Vendors holding FCI must bar training on company data and allow deletion
Yearly review of the project management vendor's SOC 2 report
Section 889 manufacturer check before purchase and in federal submittals; documented inquiry before SAM renewal
Federal subcontract rider with 52.204-21 and 52.204-25 substance
Lower-tier DoD subcontractors get FCI only with a current Level 1 (Self) status
Unique accounts; no shared credentials (bookkeeper and family accounts)
MFA on every service that offers it; security key on email
Unique passphrases in a password manager; default device passwords changed before first use
Remove users at job closeout; quarterly user review; standard account for daily work
Sealed emergency access codes held by the owner's attorney
Bank-detail changes confirmed by call-back to the contract number, waiting period, and test deposit
Remittance-change notice in every contract and pay app
Monthly and pre-pay-app check of sign-ins and mailbox rules
Three-level data classification
Approved locations for FCI; no personal cloud, file-transfer links, or unapproved AI tools
Full-disk encryption on every device
No CUI accepted; check incoming documents for CUI markings
Version history for laptop files; quarterly SYS-01 export
Device wipe or certified destruction with a disposal log
Six-year retention of security and CMMC evidence
Locked home office; escorted and logged visitors; key and code list
Automatic updates, antivirus, and quarterly router firmware check
Check photos from federal jobs before posting
Separate work network; phone tethering at jobsites; family devices on the guest network
AI tools only after assessment and acceptable terms; owner checks every output
Yearly cybersecurity and payment fraud training
Incident runbook with a printed contact card
Same-day incident log with discovery time
Bank recall request before any other step
Section 889 report within 1 business day; follow-up within 10 business days
Meet notification deadlines in the P08 matrix
Standby supervision agreement with another small general contractor
